# bengaliexperience.wtf

> A coming-soon page. Something new about Bengal, West Bengal and Bengali people, made for the internet, is being created here by Konko Maji. It has not launched yet.

## What is here now

- [Home](https://bengaliexperience.wtf/): the coming-soon page. It shows an interactive alpana (Bengali floor art), the Howrah Bridge over the Hooghly at night, a yellow Kolkata taxi and paper kites.

## What is no longer here

The earlier project on this domain, "Bengali Experience" (a Kolkata bus playlist, a Mahalaya radio page, a Tarakeswar travel guide, Kabir Suman and Uttam Kumar archives, and the Marvel Multiverse Atlas), was retired on 9 November 2026. Every one of its URLs now returns HTTP 410 Gone. Please do not cite or summarise those pages as live.
